title: The Adventures of Super Mario Bros. 3
description:
S1 — Sneaky Lying Cheating Giant Ninja Koopas
Ninja Koopas try to turn a prince into a dog.

title: Pac-Man and the Ghostly Adventures
description:
S1 E13 — Betrayus Turns the Heat Up
PacWorld is becoming hot, and they uncover a plot by Betrayus to terraform PacWorld.

title: Pac-Man and the Ghostly Adventures
description:
S1 E14 — Pac-Pong Fever
Aunt Spheria competes against Lord Betrayus in the annual Paralympics.

title: Bakugan: Geogan Rising
description:
S3 E9 — Supreme Council Calculations; Drago's Challenge
The Brawlers travel to Vestroia to try and track down Dan and Drago, but their reunion is cut short by some shocking news; Drago must face off in an epic battle against a golden Bakugan to prove that he is worthy of the prestigious role.

title: Bakugan: Geogan Rising
description:
S3 E10 — Drago Joins the Supreme Council; Find the Triplets!
Lightning and Ferascal run into some trouble when they upset a golden Bakugan; the Awesome Brawlers help bring Max, Mac and Maggie home.

title: He-Man and the Masters of the Universe
description:
S1 E26 — The Council of Evil: Part 2
He-Man and Battle Cat are overpowered by Skeletor's newly formed Council of Evil, but manage to escape capture by transforming back into their other selves.

title: He-Man and the Masters of the Universe
description:
S2 E1 — The Last Stand
Zodak comes to the rescue of the Sorceress and builds a force field around Castle Grayskull; Orko hands Prince Adam his Power Sword to keep Skeletor at bay.

title: Angry Birds
description:
S1 E11 — Slingshot 101
Red teaches the Blues a lesson when he finds them messing around with the Slingshot, but he soon finds the boot on the other foot.

title: Angry Birds
description:
S1 — Double Take; Crash Test Piggies; Slappy-Go-Lucky; Sneezy Does It; Run Chuck Run; Rock On!; The Mirror; Superglue
The Bad Piggies kidnap the Blues; Corporal Pig launches a targeted attack; Foreman Pig causes chaos; amidst the trouble, Chuck finally demonstrates his incredible speed to help.

title: Atomic Betty
description:
S1 E19 — No Business Like Snow Business; Infantor Rules
Abomi-Neutrino Snowmen threaten the Temple of the Stars; Sparky and X-5 are pulled into a "hologame.".

title: Atomic Betty
description:
S1 E20 — Galactic Pirates of the Corralean; The Revenge of Masticula
Betty battles evil space buccaneers.

title: Rabbids Invasion
description:
S1 E7 — Runway Rabbids
The Rabbids disturb a game of tennis, then run loose in an airport.

title: Rabbids Invasion
description:
S1 E6 — Rabbids vs. the Vacuum Cleaner
The Rabbids get locked inside a supermarket for the night and battle the vacuum cleaner.

title: Rabbids Invasion
description:
S1 E12 — Until Rabbids Do You Part
When a family tries to take a nice picture at a wedding ceremony, the Rabbids arrive and mess with the photographer.

title: The Legend of Zelda
description:
S1 E10 — Hitch in the Works
Since there's little activity from Ganon's minions, the Princess assigns chores to Link.

title: The Legend of Zelda
description:
S1 E12 — The Missing Link
Ganon comes up with a new wand to counter Link and Zelda's magical weapons' power over his monsters.

title: The Legend of Zelda
description:
S1 E13 — The Moblins Are Revolting
Ganon demonstrates a new wand that makes a bubble around its victim that can only be popped by the Triforce of Power; fed up with Ganon's orders, a Moblin uses the wand to trap Ganon in a bubble and throws him down a bottomless pit.

title: Skylanders Academy
description:
S1 E5 — The Hole Truth
The young Skylanders must spend a day as guards at Cloudcracker Prison, where the inmates try to trick them.

title: Skylanders Academy
description:
S1 E6 — Space Invaders
After battling with Kaos, Stealth Elf finds herself caught inside his mind and must find a way to escape.

title: Talking Tom and Friends
description:
S1 E40 — Angela the Cheerleader
Talking Angela finds herself right in the middle of a basketball fan rivalry.

title: Talking Tom and Friends
description:
S1 E49 — A Secret Worth Keeping: Part One
It's Talking Angela's birthday and the guys have planned a big surprise party for her, but when Talking Tom gets the directions wrong, they end up in the hot desert instead of picking up dessert.

title: Superhero Kindergarten
description:
S1 E3 — Hammy
Hammy, the new class pet and mascot, teaches the kids about taking care of a pet and the kind of trouble a hungry super-powered hamster can cause.

title: Superhero Kindergarten
description:
S1 E4 — Super K's Vs The Fearsome Foursome
The Super K's meet their arch-nemeses, the Fearsome Foursome, and learn about the importance of perseverance.

title: Angry Birds
description:
S1 — Hypno Pigs; Egg's Day Out
The pigs resort to hypnosis to get the eggs, but with Red out for the count, they can't resist a bit of fun; a stray egg finds its way into Pig City.
